about: VanaTvam in collaboration with Indus Herbs is an organization with a team of passionate individuals who believe that farming and leisure should be in harmony with nature. Our mission is to create Sustainable Natural Farm Communities that connect us to our ancient cultural traditions and revive them for future generations. To give you an idea of what we mean read this: Our ancient culture had a well-researched method (documented in Varahamihira’s Brihat Samhita) that says that by developing Herbal gardens like Nakshatra Vana, Navagraha Vana, Saraswathi Vana, etc. we positively enable bio-diversity which will attract birds, bees, and animals! As we like to say, we are not a me-too “Farmland Developer”, but are deeply passionate individuals who want to make this planet we call home a better place. purpose: AtVanaTvam, we believe in the power of Natural Sustainability to create a better world. All our efforts in “Natural Sustainable land practices” refers to the use and management of land resources in a way that maintains its productivity and benefits both current and future generations. This includes practices that preserve soil fertility, conserve water resources, and protect biodiversity while meeting our needs. We understand that many people would love to connect with nature and enjoy visiting and living on their own farms. Regrettably, they face obstacles like a lack of time or even knowledge of farming. We are on a mission to change that by making owning a farm simple, meaningful, and fulfilling.VanaTvam is more than just a company that creates and manages farms – we are a community that values the connections between people, nature, and food and we are passionate about creating a world where everyone can experience the joys of farming and the satisfaction of growing their own food.
